# Evals

216 questions carry a firm `evals` label: 2 appear in a candidate sitting, 40 in a compiled report, 174 in a study bank. A question counted in two sources is counted in each.

What the candidate is asked to do: explain 70, design 53, evaluate 22, diagnose 13.

These are counts of questions that were written down. They are not the probability that anyone asks them. Company names are tags copied from a bank unless the cell says *stated*, which means the candidate named the employer.
